Name: Pong
Author: CatCattyCat
Description:
[size=6]Pong[/size]
[size=3]
This mod literally replaces the SDV game with Pong. When its installed you can't play SDV anymore, only Pong against the computer.

Features:
[list]
[*]Cool title menu
[*]Score counter
[*]Pausing
[*]Sound effects
[/list]
Enjoy :)

If you actually want to play SDV (let's be real, Pong is more interesting), Platonymous has kindly [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2044]made a mod[/url] which [s]cannibalizes[/s] repurposes this mod into something actually useful! It adds an arcade you can buy as furniture and place in your house, and then play the game as a minigame whenever you want!

[/size]Requires SMAPI by Pathoschild.

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/44734342?tab=user+files][size=5]Check out my other mods by clicking here![/size][/url]

Downloads.Description: Place in your Stardew Valley/Mods folder to install.
